sample_response.text: Your bank account will be blocked today due to incomplete KYC. Update immediately: http://sbi-kyc-update.xyz

risk.label: Very high risk
risk.disclaimer: This score summarises detected warning signs. It is not a probability of fraud.

indicators.label: Threatens to block, suspend or close an account or service
Pressures you to update or verify KYC, PAN or Aadhaar

flags.label: Contains a well-known brand name but is not on our official-domain starter list (possible impersonation)
Domain contains words like verify, update, login or refund
Uses a top-level domain often seen in throwaway scam sites

urls.note: Structure-only check. The link was not opened and no reputation service was queried, so 'no flags' does not mean the link is safe.

explanation.text: This message resembles: KYC or account-block impersonation. 3 warning signs detected: creates urgency or a deadline; threatens to block, suspend or close an account or service; pressures you to update or verify kyc, pan or aadhaar. The link 'sbi-kyc-update.xyz' has 4 structural warning signs. It was not opened or checked against a reputation service. These are indicators, not proof. Verify through an official channel before acting.

actions.en: Banks do not ask you to complete KYC through a link in a message. Open your bank's official app instead.
Do not open links or call numbers in this message.
actions.te: ఈ సందేశంలోని లింక్‌లను తెరవవద్దు, నంబర్లకు కాల్ చేయవద్దు.

actions.en: Never share an OTP, PIN, password or card details with anyone.
actions.te: OTP, PIN, పాస్‌వర్డ్ లేదా కార్డ్ వివరాలను ఎవరితోనూ పంచుకోవద్దు.

actions.en: Verify independently using the official app or website, not the link in the message.
actions.te: సందేశంలోని లింక్ కాకుండా, అధికారిక యాప్ లేదా వెబ్‌సైట్ ద్వారా స్వయంగా సరిచూసుకోండి.

actions.en: If you already lost money, call 1930 immediately and report at cybercrime.gov.in.
actions.te: డబ్బు పోయినట్లయితే వెంటనే 1930 కు కాల్ చేసి, cybercrime.gov.in లో ఫిర్యాదు చేయండి.

helplines.suspected_fraud_reporting: Chakshu on the Sanchar Saathi portal (sancharsaathi.gov.in)
helplines.note: Verify these details on official government websites before relying on them.
